semiconductor_relevance: Low — the company primarily focuses on water quality analysis and wastewater treatment, with limited direct involvement in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: DH Crown Tech Co., Ltd. specializes in water quality analysis instruments and wastewater treatment solutions, serving clients in the PCB, solar energy, and semiconductor industries. They provide maintenance and refurbishment services for their equipment, aiming to enhance environmental sustainability.

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company is headquartered in Taoyuan City and serves various regions in Taiwan.
